organization.name: [REPLACE: public brand name exactly as used on the site]
organization.legal_name: [REPLACE: registered legal name, confirmed by the owner, or null]
organization.logo: [REPLACE: absolute URL of a crawlable logo image]
organization.founding_date: [REPLACE: YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD from a verifiable record, or null]

contact_points.url: [REPLACE: absolute URL of the published contact page]
contact_points.email: [REPLACE: only an address already published on the site, or null]
contact_points.telephone: [REPLACE: only a number already published on the site, or null]

address.street_address: [REPLACE: or null when there is no public address]

people.name: [REPLACE: full name as published on the author or team page]
people.url: [REPLACE: absolute URL of that person's page on the site]
people.job_title: [REPLACE: title confirmed by the person or the owner]

definition_sentence: [REPLACE: one factual sentence such as 'Example Co is an invoicing service for small teams.' reused unchanged on the home page, About page, README and listings]
wikidata_qid: [REPLACE: Q-number of an existing item that is verified to describe this organization, or null]
verified_by: [REPLACE: role of the person who confirmed every value above]
